results.title: Solar Lamp Post Light with Planter, Black
results.before:
The Garden Solar Lamp Post Light is the perfect combination of vintage charm and modern technology, crafted from durable ABS and aluminium materials to withstand the elements. Standing at 160 cm tall, this elegant black post light comes with a dual-purpose planter base measuring 33 cm, allowing for personalisation with seasonal flowers. 

This solar-powered light offers a warm glow with a brightness of 50 lumens and a colour temperature of 3200 Kelvin, creating an inviting atmosphere for your outdoor spaces such as pathways, gardens, and driveways. Its user-friendly design allows for easy solar charging, making it a practical choice for illuminating your porch or terrace. 

With a robust construction and IP44 waterproof rating, this lamp post is designed for outdoor use, ensuring reliability in various weather conditions. Enjoy hassle-free installation, as no electrical contracting is required, and benefit from the automatic dusk-to-dawn functionality that adds convenience to your outdoor lighting experience.
results.after: A 160cm solar lamp post in black ABS and aluminium, with a 33cm square planter built into the base. One warm LED puts out 50 lumens at 3200K, and a dusk-to-dawn sensor turns it on at sunset and off again at sunrise. There's no wiring to run, so it only needs a spot that gets enough sun to charge. Rated IP44 for outdoor use.
